_comment: Runtime config for the artcoins UI. Edited and re-uploaded as a static asset — does NOT require a frontend rebuild. defaultReferrer is the address credited as the referrer when a visitor swaps without a `?ref=0x...` URL parameter. URL-attributed swaps (`?ref=0xfriend`) always override. Set to the canonical protocol payout address (the same value used for the team/creator fee and the title-auction payout) so default-referrer revenue lands in one place. Change by editing this file and re-deploying — operator only.
